children: Scribe Therapeutics reported second-quarter 2026 results showing collaboration revenue of $1.9 million and a net loss of $6.5 million (or $2.62 per basic and diluted share). Cash, cash equivalents, and marketable securities were $43.0 million as of June 30, 2026, and the company raised approximately $155.5 million of aggregate gross proceeds from a July 2026 IPO and concurrent private placement. The company also initiated a first-in-human Phase 1 trial of STX-1150 and secured CIRM grants to advance two additional cardiometabolic programs.
Collaboration revenue: $1.9 million for the three months ended June 30, 2026 (down from $4.9 million year-ago).
Research and development expenses: $8.8 million for Q2 2026 (compared with $13.9 million in Q2 2025).
General and administrative expenses: $2.5 million for Q2 2026 (compared with $2.6 million in Q2 2025).
Net loss: $6.5 million for Q2 2026, or $2.62 per basic and diluted share (net loss of $9.9 million, or $4.08 per share, in Q2 2025).
Balance sheet: Cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities of $43.0 million as of June 30, 2026; total assets $57.9 million and total liabilities $102.4 million as of June 30, 2026.

Initiated first-in-human Phase 1 trial of STX-1150 (ELXR epigenetic silencing therapy targeting PCSK9) in Australia to evaluate safety, tolerability and LDL-C lowering activity; initial clinical data expected in H1 2027.

Presented late-breaking non-human primate data showing up to 90% PCSK9 silencing and up to 68% LDL-C reduction after a single dose of an STX-1150 ELXR prototype, with durable reductions at relevant dose for two years and comparable liver enzyme profiles to controls.

Awarded approximately $25.7 million in combined non-dilutive grants from the California Institute for Regenerative Medicine to advance STX-1200 (Lp(a) lowering, X-Editor) and STX-1400 (APOC3/triglyceride lowering, X-Editor) toward clinical entry as early as 2027.

Completed upsized initial public offering and concurrent private placement to Sanofi in July 2026, generating approximately $155.5 million in aggregate gross proceeds and Nasdaq listing on July 24, 2026; company expects funding into the first half of 2029 when combining IPO proceeds with existing cash.

Published updated ELXR platform findings (bioRxiv) describing engineering improvements that increase on-target activity and reduce off-targets, and introduced an allosterically gated sequential proofreading mechanism for epigenetic therapies.
